RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 21, 2005/Agrahayana 30, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs;
Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles)
————
Total number of questions — 20
Jehanabad Jail attack
†*401. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ:
SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating on formulating any joint
policy with Nepal to combat maoists after
the incident committed by naxalites in
Jehanabad;
(b) if so, the steps taken so far in this
regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Procurement made by DGS & D for
WB/ADB aided projects
*402. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of procurement made by
DGS & D for World Bank/Asian
Development Bank aided projects for the
last three years and also the purchases
effected in terms of indents, number of
contracts and the value of contracts placed
for the last three years;
(b) has there been some unevenness
with respect to purchase effected from
different regions, if so, the reasons for
same;
(c) what is the system to check the
quality of stores received; and
(d) whether the test check under the
system of quality audit is foolproof, if so,
the statistics of complaints received in the
last three years?
Boiler Act legislation
*403. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of  COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any complaints from Boiler Industrialists
that they are facing problems due to non-
essential boiler rules;
(b) if so, Government's response
thereto;
(c) what is the present status of
bringing out a Boiler Act legislation in
Parliament; and

bringing this Act?
Incidents of rape, loot, dacoities and
other criminal activities in trains
†*404. SHRI AJAY MAROO:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the incidents of rape,
loot, dacoities and other criminal activities
in trains in Jharkhand and other States;
(b) whether there is any specific criteria
to fix the responsibility in this matter;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what measures have been taken for
the safety of lives and property of
passengers travelling by train?
Criteria of Rural Employment
Guarantee Scheme
*405. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) what is the criteria of Rural
Employment Guarantee Scheme and
whether Government have identified those
rural areas where there are lots of
unemployed youths;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether monitoring mechanism has
been fixed by Government so that the lot
of youths may get employment?
Development of wastelands
*406. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI K. B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
 Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of wastelands in the
country as on date;
(b) what is the policy of Government
to develop wastelands and quantum of
funds allocated for the same during the last
three years;
(c) the quantum of wastelands
developed during the last three years,
State-wise; and
(d) whether there is any policy of
Government to distribute wastelands
amongst landless peasants?
Import of agricultural produce
*407. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of agricultural produce
imported during the last three years showing
the countries from where they were
imported;
(b) whether the imported agricultural
produce is used for domestic consumption
or for processing and export or both;
(c) details of concessions, if any,
provided to importers during this period;
and
(d) the steps taken to bring down the
import of agricultural produce?
Automatic lights at metro stations
†*408. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering on making such provision at
metro stations that the lights would be on
as soon as it gets dark and with the break
of dawn the lights would go off
automatically;
(b) if so, whether Government are

126
considering on making such provision
throughout the country; if so, the details
thereof;
(c) the extent to which this provision
would put a check on theft of power; and
(d) by when this provision would be
implemented?
Linking of army hospitals with private
hospitals
*409. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to link army
hospitals with private hospitals to provide
service to defence personnel;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether army personnel are eligible
for medical insurance cover for heart, burns

598
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 21, 2005/Agrahayana 30, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —155
India-EU trade
3042. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India-EU
proposes to set up a joint study group to
explore possibility of bilateral agreement
that encompasses investment and trade;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether EU is India's largest trading
partner and the biggest source of FDI; and
(d) if so, the details of EU-India trade
during 2004 and what are our future
estimates?
Assistance to States for development
of export infrastructure
3043. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is providing financial assistance to States
under "Assistance to States for
development of infrastructure and allied
activities for the development of export
infrastructure;"
(b) if so, the details of assistance that
Government is providing to Andhra
Pradesh during the last five years, year-
wise;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government has rejected the additional
assistance demanded by States without
citing any reasons;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether Government of Andhra
Pradesh has asked for extending the scheme
to develop other export facilities; and
(f) if so, the reasons therefor?
Parlours by Tea Board in Tamil Nadu
3044. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up parlours by Tea Board in Conoor and

599
other near by locations to promote tea;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is proposed to set up such
parlours in other locations in Tamil Nadu;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Export of different commodities
3045. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that five
commodities-transport equipment,
petroleum-crude and products; machinery
and instruments, gems and jewellery and
ready-made garments including accessories
accounted for 42 per cent of country's
aggregate exports during the current year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that despite
initial setbacks, textiles exports and
clothings have picked up and recorded a
good export growth during April-May,
2005;
(d) which are the other items which
have shown significant growth in exports;
and
(e) what is the action plan of
Government to give a further fillip to export
of these items?
Agreement between India and Belarus
to double trade
3046. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India and
Belarus have entered into an agreement to
double their trade;
(b) if so, the details of the tie-ups
between the two countries to achieve the
objective; and
(c) what is the present status of trade
between the two countries and which are
the main items of trade?
Cost reduction in Indian industry
3047. SHRI ANAND SHARMA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what efforts are being made to
introduce cost reduction in Indian Industry
to improve its competitive strength vis-a-
vis Chinese industries; and
(b) whether Government is considering
a proposal to provide imports and
international prices to the Industry?
UNCTAD survey on FDI prospects
3048. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether according to an United
Nations Conference on Trade and
Development survey on Foreign Direct
Investment prospects for 2005-06,
covering 81 countries, India occupies the
second position, next only to China as the
most attractive investment destination
after China  for Transnational
Corporations;
(b) if so, what percentage of
Transnational Corporations found China,
India, US, UK, Russia and Pakistan; as
attractive destination; and
(c) what steps have been and are being
taken or contemplated by Government to
make India a more attractive investment
destination by multinationals?

600
Action against major publishing
houses and cigarette companies
3049. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether action has been initiated
against some major publishing houses and
cigarette companies for violation of the
"Tobacco Products (Prohibition of
Advertisement and Regulation of Trade And
Commerce, Production, Supply and
Distribution) Act, 2003; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Visit of Defence Minister to North
East in September, 2005

(a) whether his visi
